full_text: At 49, he beat surfers half his age. At the world's deadliest wave. Kelly Slater, a kid from Florida, became the youngest world surfing champion in history at 20. He won five more titles, retired at the top, and came back - to win five more in his thirties. At 39, he became the oldest world champion ever. He holds both ends of the record. Along the way: fifty-six tour wins, the all-time record. Eleven world titles. Nobody else in the sport's history has more than eight. Time beats every athlete. In 2022, days before turning fifty, Slater paddled out at Pipeline one more time...
